verdict.rationale: Segment's Profile API is well documented as a single programmatic API to query user- and account-level profiles including external_ids, traits, and events, backed by Identity Resolution's ID graph; the Profile explorer UI complements the store-based access. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the Profile API in production use and detailed rate-limit/query-pattern documentation beyond the marketing-style docs excerpts.
